plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "left-digit effect" OR ".99 pricing" OR "9-ending prices") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets evidence on charm-price and left-digit mechanisms behind conversion and purchase response.

queries.query: ("price discount" OR "sales promotion" OR "temporary price reduction" OR coupon OR rebate) AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR branding)
queries.rationale: Catches research on whether promotions lift conversion versus erode margins, quality perceptions, or brand value.

queries.query: ("reference price" OR "price anchoring" OR "anchor price" OR "internal reference price") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR pricing)
queries.rationale: Finds work on list-price anchors, comparative pricing, and how price context changes willingness to buy.

queries.query: ("price framing" OR "partitioned pricing" OR "drip pricing" OR "shipping surcharge") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR pricing)
queries.rationale: Surfaces studies on how the way total price is presented affects checkout completion and perceived fairness.

queries.query: ("scarcity appeal" OR "limited-time offer" OR "limited quantity" OR "stock scarcity") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Captures evidence on countdowns, low-stock messages, and urgency cues that may help or hurt conversion.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "bandwagon effect" OR "popularity cue" OR "best-seller label") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Targets experiments on whether popularity signals and peer-choice cues increase clicks, purchases, or trust.

queries.query: ("online review" OR "review valence" OR "review helpfulness" OR "star rating") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR platform)
queries.rationale: Finds research on how review volume, sentiment, and ratings shape conversion and product choice online.

queries.query: ("advertising creativity" OR "ad creativity" OR "creative effectiveness" OR "message appeal") AND (advertising OR marketing OR consumer OR branding OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Covers what kinds of creative and message structures drive response rather than just impressions or recall.

queries.query: ("emotional appeal" OR "informational appeal" OR "gain-loss framing" OR "message framing") AND (advertising OR marketing OR consumer OR persuasion OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Pulls in evidence on framing and appeal type that affects persuasion, click-through, and purchase intent.

queries.query: ("visual attention" OR "image complexity" OR "visual salience" OR "product imagery") AND (advertising OR marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail)
queries.rationale: Targets findings on which visual design features attract attention and improve product-page or ad performance.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR "product page" OR "checkout page" OR "conversion rate optimization") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR marketing OR consumer OR experimentation)
queries.rationale: Finds research directly tied to page-level design and experimentation on conversion outcomes in digital commerce.

queries.query: ("choice architecture" OR "default option" OR nudging OR "behavioral nudge") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR "behavioral economics")
queries.rationale: Captures practical behavioral interventions that alter choice without changing core economics of the offer.

queries.query: ("product name" OR "brand name" OR "brand naming" OR "name fluency") AND (marketing OR consumer OR branding OR retail OR linguistics)
queries.rationale: Surfaces evidence on naming features like fluency, sound symbolism, and memorability that affect evaluation and sales.

queries.query: ("brand dilution" OR "promotion spillover" OR "price promotion" OR "discount framing") AND (branding OR marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Focuses specifically on when promotions backfire by lowering quality perceptions, luxury associations, or long-run preference.

queries.query: ("purchase intention" OR "willingness to pay" OR "conversion rate" OR "purchase likelihood") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR experiment)
queries.rationale: Provides a broader evidence-oriented catchment for studies reporting purchase and conversion outcomes relevant to practitioners.

queries.query: ("field experiment" OR "A/B test" OR "online experiment" OR "randomized experiment") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Prioritizes papers using experimental designs likely to yield actionable numeric findings over purely conceptual work.

plan.coverage_notes: The plan emphasizes high-utility levers for an e-commerce growth marketer: pricing, promotion, checkout nudges, creative, reviews, and naming, with several queries aimed at direct conversion or willingness-to-pay outcomes. It deliberately skips advertising history, media theory, and broad branding theory unless tied to measurable purchase behavior. I assumed the reader values practitioner-relevant experiments and quantitative consumer-response research more than channel-specific tactics or platform case studies.
